application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
T1 & T2: Lime x 2 Tilia SP 
Crown Reduction - Retaining Furnishing Growth 
Reduce the crown to manage overall size and end-weight while retaining furnishing (fine, well-distributed) growth throughout the crown.
Reduction to be carried out evenly, maintaining a natural, balanced crown shape appropriate to the species.
Final pruning cuts to suitable secondary growth points to encourage healthy regrowth.
No topping or excessive removal of primary framework limbs
Works to improve light levels, reduce sail effect, and maintain long term tree health

T3: Olive (Olea europaea) - Crown to be reshaped and lightly reduced to restore a tidy, balanced form
Remove crossing, congested, and poorly placed growth
Retain the tree's characteristic habit while improving structure and appearance
Cuts made with consideration to future growth and flowering


Reason for works:
General tree maintenance
